observed: One meeting participant leans close to whisper to another, who looks thoughtfully toward an empty chair; other participants sit behind.
meaning_fit: Fits invented private-report setting without treating closeness as proof, labeling anyone guilty or assigning a spouse. Empty chair is an imagined visual element, not evidence of a particular target.
recommended_alt: A participant whispers to a seated listener at a meeting table; the listener rests his chin on his hand and looks toward an empty chair.
recommended_caption: An imagined meeting invites caution about judging someone from a private report alone.
